title: One Teacher, Many Views: Reducing Reference Sensitivity in On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30880v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a model on its own trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a privileged copy conditioned on a reference solution. Existing methods typically use a single teacher distribution conditioned on the complete reference. We identify a limitation of this formulation: a reference is only one realization of the reasoning process. Although it provides evidence about the answer, it also encodes an ordering, phrasing, and solution path. Full-reference conditioning can therefore produce correct targets that depend excessively on information unavailable to the student at inference. We show that replacing one valid reference with another, while holding the problem and student state fixed, can substantially alter the teacher distribution, a phenomenon we call reference-induced target instability. translated_title: 一个教师，多个视角：降低在线策略自蒸馏中的参考敏感性
translated_abstract: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过在模型自身生成的轨迹上进行训练，并利用一个以参考解答为条件的特权副本提供密集的token级监督，从而提升推理能力。现有方法通常使用以完整参考为条件的单一教师分布。我们发现了这种形式的一个局限性：参考只是推理过程的一种实现方式。尽管它提供了关于答案的证据，但它同时编码了特定的顺序、措辞和求解路径。因此，以完整参考为条件可能会产生过度依赖于学生模型在推理时无法获得的信息的正确目标。我们证明，在保持问题和学生状态不变的情况下，用一个有效参考替换另一个有效参考，会显著改变教师分布，我们将这种现象称为参考诱导的目标不稳定性。为了解决这种不稳定性，我们引入了蒙特卡洛特权蒸馏（
tldr: 本文发现在线策略自蒸馏中单一完整参考条件会导致教师分布对参考的选择高度敏感（参考诱导的目标不稳定性），并提出蒙特卡洛特权蒸馏方法，通过利用参考的多个视角来降低这种参考敏感性。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies reference-induced target instability in on-policy self-distillation—where swapping one valid reference for another substantially alters the teacher distribution—and proposes Monte Carlo Privileged Distillation to reduce this reference sensitivity by leveraging multiple views of the reference.
